name: YV-580 light freighter
description: The YV-580 was a model of light freighter manufactured by the Corellian Engineering Corporation. It consisted of a dish-shaped middle section which featured the starship's cockpit, and two side-mounted prongs armed with laser cannons on the inner and outer sides. A YV-580 named the Broken Wing was used by bounty hunter Beilert Valance, who modified the ship to suit his needs.
